original_question: Design a Verilog module named `adder16`. This module should have the following interface: inputs `clk`, `rst`, `A` (16 bits), `B` (16 bits), and a 16-bit registered output `Z`. The module should compute the sum of inputs `A` and `B` and store the result in `Z`. This sum calculation and storage should happen synchronously with the rising edge of the clock `clk`. Additionally, the module must include a synchronous reset `rst` which, when active, sets the output `Z` to zero.
